simple.prompt: When we arrived at the boarding gate, the international flight ___ already departed.
simple.explanation: Pesawat berangkat LEBIH DULU sebelum kita tiba di gerbang. Rumus Past Perfect: 'had' + past participle (V3): 'had already departed'.
hints: Peristiwa terjadi lebih awal di masa lalu sebelum peristiwa lampau lainnya.

simple.prompt: She couldn't access the database because she ___ her credentials at home.
simple.explanation: Tindakan meninggalkan kartu identitas terjadi LEBIH AWAL daripada ketidakmampuan mengakses pintu. Gunakan 'had left'.
hints: Sebab terjadi sebelum akibat di masa lampau.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Past Perfect dengan kata hubung 'before'.
simple.targetSentence: He had finished the report before the meeting started.
simple.explanation: Aksi pertama yang lebih awal: 'He had finished the report' + before + aksi kedua: 'the meeting started'.
hints: Aksi yang selesai lebih awal memakai 'had finished'.

simple.prompt: By the time the emergency backup generator kicked in, the servers ___ completely.
simple.explanation: Frasa 'By the time + Past Simple' berpasangan dengan Past Perfect: 'had shut down'.
hints: Frasa 'By the time' menandakan batas waktu sebelum aksi lain.

simple.targetSentence: They had not seen the revised guidelines before the audit.
simple.explanation: Subject (They) + had not + V3 (seen) + the revised guidelines before the audit.
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'the revised guidelines before the audit'.

simple.prompt: The engineer felt confident during the test because he ___ thoroughly for three weeks.
simple.explanation: Persiapan tiga minggu terjadi sebelum ujian berlangsung di masa lalu: 'had prepared'.

simple.targetSentence: Had you met the regional director before yesterday?
simple.explanation: Had + Subject (you) + V3 (met) + Object (the regional director) + before yesterday?

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog klarifikasi urutan kejadian masa lalu.
dialogue: Why was the press release delayed?
Because legal ___ the draft before we submitted it to the media.
intermediate.explanation: Penyebab sebelum pengiriman adalah persetujuan legal yang belum keluar: 'had not approved'.
hints: Gunakan Past Perfect negatif 'had not approved'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference: 'When the meeting started, the manager arrived' (Sequence: after) vs 'When the meeting started, the manager ___' (Already there: earlier).
intermediate.explanation: Jika manajer sudah ada di ruangan SEBELUM rapat dimulai, gunakan Past Perfect: 'had already arrived'. Jika manajer baru tiba SETELAH rapat mulai, gunakan Past Simple 'arrived'.
hints: Manajer sudah ada di sana lebih awal sebelum rapat dimulai.

intermediate.prompt: By 2020, the software enterprise ___ over one hundred million registered users worldwide.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa 'By + titik waktu lampau' (By 2020) adalah penanda baku tuntasnya pencapaian sebelum waktu tersebut, sehingga memakai Past Perfect: 'had acquired'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan konjungsi urutan 'as soon as' dan Past Perfect.
intermediate.targetSentence: As soon as he had signed the contract he left the office.
intermediate.explanation: As soon as + Past Perfect (he had signed the contract) + Past Simple (he left the office).
hints: Mulai dengan 'As soon as he had signed the contract'.

intermediate.prompt: I didn't recognize my childhood classmate because he ___ so significantly.
intermediate.explanation: Perubahan fisik terjadi bertahap selama bertahun-tahun SEBELUM momen perjumpaan di masa lalu: 'had changed'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman pertama di masa lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: It was the first time she had flown on a commercial aircraft.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam konteks narasi lampau: 'It was the first time + Past Perfect (she had flown)'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'It was the first time'.
Gunakan Past Perfect: 'she had flown on a commercial aircraft'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat Past Perfect yang tepat.
dialogue: Had the client submitted the tax compliance form prior to the deadline?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif untuk pertanyaan 'Had they...?' adalah 'Yes, they had.'

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan overusing Past Perfect ketika urutan kejadian sudah sepenuhnya jelas melalui 'before' atau 'after'.
complex.draft: After the conference had concluded, the delegates had departed for the airport.
options: After the conference concluded, the delegates departed for the airport.
After the conference has concluded, the delegates had departed for the airport.
After the conference had been concluding, the delegates were departing for the airport.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku modern, jika kata hubung 'before' atau 'after' sudah secara gamblang memperjelas urutan kronologis, tidak perlu menumpuk Past Perfect pada kedua klausa. Gunakan Past Simple yang elegan: 'After the conference concluded, the delegates departed...'.
hints: Hindari menumpuk Past Perfect ganda di kedua klausa.
Gunakan Past Simple pada kedua aksi yang dihubungkan 'after'.

complex.prompt: Pola inversi dramatis sastra dengan 'Hardly ... when': 'Hardly ___ the auditorium when the keynote address commenced.'
complex.explanation: Pola inversi naratif: 'Hardly + had + Subject + V3... when + Past Simple' (Baru saja... ketika...).

complex.prompt: Pola inversi 'No sooner ... than': 'No sooner ___ the security patch than another vulnerability was detected.'
complex.explanation: Pola inversi korelatif: 'No sooner + had + Subject + V3... THAN + Past Simple' (Tidak lama setelah... langsung...).
hints: Memerlukan inversi Past Perfect: 'No sooner had the engineers deployed'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat penyesalan hipotetis masa lampau (Third Conditional).
complex.targetSentence: If you had informed me earlier I would have assisted you.
complex.explanation: Third conditional: If + Past Perfect (had informed me earlier) + would have + V3 (assisted you).
hints: Klausa if: 'If you had informed me earlier'.
Klausa hasil: 'I would have assisted you'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan pengandaian masa lampau dengan 'wish'.
complex.draft: I wish I studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
options: I wish I had studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
I wish I have studied software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
I wish I would study software engineering instead of economics when I was at university.
complex.explanation: Untuk menyatakan penyesalan atas peristiwa masa lalu yang sudah tidak bisa diubah (past regret), setelah 'wish' WAJIB menggunakan Past Perfect: 'I wish I had studied...'.
hints: Penyesalan terhadap masa lalu yang sudah lewat.
Gunakan 'wish + Past Perfect': 'wish I had studied'.

complex.prompt: We had hoped that the regulatory body ___ the merger, but they blocked it on antitrust grounds.
complex.explanation: Harapan masa lalu yang tidak terwujud (unfulfilled past hope: 'We had hoped that...') diikuti oleh 'would + base verb'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis kegagalan sistem dengan Third Conditional.
dialogue: Why did the transaction crash the payment gateway?
If we ___ the stress test yesterday, this wouldn't have occurred.
complex.explanation: Kondisi pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi (Third Conditional): 'If we had executed...'.
